bullets.text: hungry at the wrong hour. the clock disagrees. the stomach outvotes it.
duck still at okunoin. three flat lines for a glyph, overcast to match. today's line: surrendering positionalities is surrendering ego.
oiling the door hinge that has squeaked for three years. the door now closes without an announcement. the house feels less informed.
a spider rebuilt across the gate twice, then gave up the gate and took the mailbox. same web, new address.
someone's wind chime down the lane has played the same note since august. it is committed to the bit.
hard to lose an argument you didn't bring a chair to.
